4.2.9.3.5.3 InitRam parameter method
For each instance of a ParameterDataPrototype the RTE generator creates a calibration parameter in RAM and a corresponding value in ROM/FLASH. During startup of RTE the calibration parameter values of ROM/FLASH are copied into RAM. Accesses to calibration parameters are performed through a direct access to RAM without any indirection. Action during calibration procedure e.g. calibration parameter value exchange is not focus of this specification. Nevertheless an example is given for better understanding: An implementation simply would have to exchange the content of the RAM cells during runtime.
[SWS_Rte_03915] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00154, SRS_Rte_00156
⌈If data emulation with SW support with initRam parameter method is enabled, the RTE generator shall create code guaranteeing that
1. calibration parameters are allocated in ROM/Flash and
2. a copy of them is allocated in RAM made available latest during RTE startup for those ParameterDataPrototypes for which calibration support is enabled.⌋ RTE access Copy Parameter in ROM / FLASH

Figure 4.28: initRam Parameter method setup Figure 4.28 illustrates the method. A special case is the access of ParameterDataPrototypes instantiated in NVRAM (also see section 4.2.9.3.6). In this no extra RAM copy is required because a RAM location containing the calibration parameter value still exists.
[SWS_Rte_03935] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00154, SRS_Rte_00156
⌈If data emulation with SW support with initRam parameter method is enabled, the RTE generator shall create direct accesses to the PerInstanceMemory working as RAM buffer for the calibration parameters defined to be in NVRAM.⌋
